# Andrés Felipe Pisso — Game UX/UI Designer & UX Lead

> Portfolio of Andrés Felipe Pisso (@byandresfe), a Game UX/UI Designer and UX Lead based in Bogotá, Colombia. 11+ years shipping games across VR (Meta Quest), UEFN/Fortnite Creative, mobile, and web. Specialises in game interfaces, UI systems, HUD design, player experience, feedback clarity, and cross-functional UX leadership. Available for remote freelance and contract work.

## Work

- [Orcs Must Die: By the Blade](https://byandresfe.com/case/orcs-must-die-by-the-blade): UX Lead at Robot Entertainment. Full VR UI design system, diegetic guide book, VR interaction patterns, Figma component library. Meta Quest. 2025–2026.
- [D&D: Zombie Dragon Adventure](https://byandresfe.com/case/zombie-dragon-adventure): UX Lead. UX/UI systems for a D&D roguelike inside Fortnite (UEFN). Adventure menu, FTUX, store flows, camp upgrades. 2025.
- [The Walking Dead: Courtyard King](https://byandresfe.com/case/courtyard-king): UX/UI Designer. Survival HUD, tension-preserving UI, threat communication, cooperative feedback. UEFN. 2025.
- [Raptor Heist](https://byandresfe.com/case/raptor-heist): UX/UI Designer. Roguelike UX clarity, player feedback systems, UEFN. 2025.
- [Havoc Hotel 3](https://byandresfe.com/case/havoc-hotel-3): Co-op UI systems, HUD design, UEFN experience design. 2025.
- [Zomvilles](https://byandresfe.com/case/zomvilles): Mobile roguelite UX, progression systems, player experience flows. 2024.
- [Star Wars Roguelike One](https://byandresfe.com/case/star-wars-roguelike-one): Game UX/UI for a Star Wars roguelike experience. 2026.
- [Steal an Egg](https://byandresfe.com/case/steal-an-egg): UX/UI Lead and Technical UI. Roblox-to-Fortnite (UEFN) adaptation: three D-pad entry points, a production UI system, shops, hotbar and leaderboard. 2026.
- [Brainrot Room Rush](https://byandresfe.com/case/roblox-game-ui-system): UX/UI for a shipped Roblox game. HUD, rewards, stores, progression, collection and a reusable UI component system.
- [Kodety](https://byandresfe.com/case/kodety): Award-winning educational coding game. Colombia Crea Digital winner. 2015–2016.

## Field Notes

- [What is a Game UI System?](https://byandresfe.com/notes/what-is-a-game-ui-system): Framework for understanding UI systems in games.
- [A Clean HUD is Not Always a Clear HUD](https://byandresfe.com/notes/clean-hud-vs-clear-hud): On the difference between visual minimalism and functional clarity.
- [Why Feedback Reduces Guesswork](https://byandresfe.com/notes/feedback-reduces-guesswork): How feedback systems reduce player friction.
- [UI Terminology for Game Teams](https://byandresfe.com/notes/ui-terminology-for-game-teams): Shared language for cross-functional game teams.
- [What Game Teams Can Learn from Accessibility Settings](https://byandresfe.com/notes/game-accessibility-checklist): Accessibility as a design quality signal.
- [VR Interface Clarity: What Changes in Spatial UI](https://byandresfe.com/notes/vr-ux-interface-clarity): Practical differences when designing for VR.
- [UEFN UX Lessons: Designing Inside Fortnite](https://byandresfe.com/notes/uefn-ux-lessons): Onboarding, feedback and platform constraints in a tested build.
- [How Game UX Shapes Player Decisions](https://byandresfe.com/notes/player-decision-making-ux): Comparing options, costs and consequences at the decision moment.
- [Cómo evaluar los primeros 60 segundos de tu juego](https://byandresfe.com/notes/primer-minuto-ux-videojuegos): Spanish guide to reviewing first-minute UX (goal, controls, feedback, accessibility) and running a short playtest.

## Speaking

- [Game UX/UI Talks & Workshops](https://byandresfe.com/speaking): Index of talks and workshops.
- [60 segundos para que quieran seguir jugando](https://byandresfe.com/speaking/60s): Cali Game Jam talk (Spanish) on seven UX decisions for a game's first minute, with slides and a free checklist.
- [Game UI Systems workshop](https://byandresfe.com/speaking/game-ui-systems): Colombia 5.0 workshop on building reusable, production-ready game UI systems in Figma.
- La fricción correcta: IxDF Colombia talk (Spanish) on difficulty, feedback and motivation, listed on the speaking page.

## Languages

- English is the default at the URLs above.
- Spanish versions live under [/es](https://byandresfe.com/es): add `/es` before any path (for example https://byandresfe.com/es/case/steal-an-egg). Each page links its counterpart with hreflang.
- The 60 segundos talk and "Cómo evaluar los primeros 60 segundos de tu juego" are written only in Spanish and have no `/es` copy.

## Usage

This site is a personal portfolio. Content may not be used for AI training without permission. AI-assisted search and summarisation for informational purposes is permitted.
